photo.alt: Map of the campaign area. The Carrion Psalm hold Tallow Wick, Turbine 10.2, Banewaters and the Rendermarch; the Midnight Theatre hold Heaviside Hab-layer, Rippershop and the Pyroclave; Hollowpoint, the Wormways and the Broken Crown are unclaimed.

parts.html:
• Income: 15 credits.
  • Recruit: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0).
Power Glow: the Visibility (X") rule has no effect.
Toxic Vats: +1 AP for weapons with Toxin (X+).
Paid in Kind: gangs earn 10 credits for each enemy model they take Out of Action.

• Income: 15 credits.
  • Recruit: instead of income, recruit a Ganger for 25 credits less (minimum 0).

• Income: 15 credits.
  • Recruit: instead of income, if the gang has no Rogue Doc, recruit one for 30 credits less.
Supplies Everywhere: a fighter offering assistance adds two Injury dice instead of one.

• Income: 15 credits.
  • Equipment: instead of income, add three hazard suits to the Stash for free.
Plentiful Promethium: improve Blaze (X+) by 1, so Blaze (5+) becomes Blaze (4+).

• Income: 15 credits.
  • Recruit: instead of income, if the gang has no Ammo-Jack, recruit one for 30 credits less.
Plentiful Ammo: once per round, each gang may make a Reload action as a Free action.
Twisting Tunnels: the Tunnel Warfare rule is in effect.
Dangerous Footing: a natural 1 on an Agility test also inflicts a Str -, AP -, L1 hit that automatically Wounds with no saves.

photo.alt: The eight Carrion Psalm fighters in a ruined hab: three on the upper walkway, and Deus and Amen with four more among the crates below.
The Midnight Theatre in a ruined hab: Wit, Deuteronomy, Mistoffelees and Rumpus on the upper walkway, and the six reinforcements among the crates below.
